Shop By Outing

Whether you're logging miles or setting up camp, the outing shapes the kit. Start with where you're going.

Day hikes cover 3–8 miles. Your dog needs hydration, paw protection, a way to carry their own water, and the means to deal with mud and heat. Build the kit around the season and the trail length.
